units.text: 1. Violation by the editor-in-chief or editorial office of a mass media outlet, a television and (or) radio broadcasting organisation, or another organisation producing or distributing a mass media outlet, of the procedure for publishing (making public) materials relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums, including campaign materials, or violation during an election campaign or referendum campaign of the procedure for publishing (making public) those materials in information and telecommunications networks access to which is not restricted to a specified group of persons —

units.locator: Article 5.5. Violation of the procedure for participation by the mass media in providing information for elections, referendums and all-Russian voting

units.locator: Article 5.5. Violation of the procedure for participation by the mass media in providing information for elections, referendums and all-Russian voting
units.text: 2. units.label: Part 2 Art. 5.5

units.locator: Article 5.5. Violation of the procedure for participation by the mass media in providing information for elections, referendums and all-Russian voting
